text:
NASA FIRMS detected no fire on this asset (ASSET-F01) between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-23. Zero thermal detections intersected the asset boundary. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of the period, so the lack of detections is not due to gaps in coverage.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may escape thermal detection. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any land change (harvest, storm, clearing or fire), or anything outside this period.

In short: no satellite-detected fire, with full sensor coverage, but a small or brief fire can't be fully ruled out. The evidence is current (version 1, as of 2026-11-12).
